name: Set-Theoretic Certificate Abstraction
description: Removes the explicit algorithmic checklist of inequalities and replaces it with a generic condition on abstract sets of operations. The model must perform a semantic translation to realize that the set of "operations belonging to job i" maps to $p_{i,1} + p_{i,2}$, and the set of "operations executed on Server c" maps to $\sum p_{k,c}$.
